extracted.name: Beef stroganoff pasta
extracted.description: A different approach to pasta dish if you want to stay away from tomato based pasta for a while.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 pounds beef sirloin steak, 1/2 inch thick
4 tablespoons all purpose flour or cornstarch
instruction_lines: Sauté onions, garlic and mushrooms in butter until cooked and set aside
Sauté beef in the same pan you used for the onions. Put pepper, salt and soy sauce until golden brown. Pour beef broth and cook for 20 minutes.
Put sour cream and flour. Simmer for five minutes and pour onion mixture.
Cook egg noodles according to package. Garnish with chopped parsley.
